Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
I'm currently reading tome 3 of the Clan Lasombra Trilogy (and am very
disappointed in what's happening to one of my favourite characters, but
that's another subject). In this cycle, we see lots of weird ways to use
Obtenebration, invoke the Abyss, make rituals etc. I was wondering if there
is a rulebook stating how to do this.

--
Yours from the Grave,

Orpheus

Probably not. Authors of novels tend to take *a lot* of liberty with the RPG
material in their writing. That's why most novels are quasi-canon, at best.
